ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS AS (
SELECT 
	BCC.ORGKEY as CustomerID
	,TMDATE as PeriodStartDate
	,convert(date,NULL) as PeriodEndDate
	,BCC.MARITAL_STATUS as MaritalStatusID
	,NULL as CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC_DELTA BCCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCC
ON BCCD.DEMOGRAPHICID = BCC.DEMOGRAPHICID
    AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID
    AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	WHERE  BCC.ACCOUNTID <> 0 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerID, MaritalStatusID)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerID
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(CustomerID, MaritalStatusID)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerID
		,FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS SRC ON SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE  TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;

-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS (
	[CustomerId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[MaritalStatusId]
	,[CustomerMaritalStatusNote]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	SRC.CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerID = SRC.CustomerID AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'



-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS (
	[CustomerId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[MaritalStatusId]
	,[CustomerMaritalStatusNote]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA;

END
